## CredentialsModule.negotiateProposal() method

Negotiate a credential proposal as issuer (by sending a credential offer message) to the connection associated with the credential record.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
negotiateProposal(credentialRecordId: string, preview: CredentialPreview, config?: {
        comment?: string;
        credentialDefinitionId?: string;
        autoAcceptCredential?: AutoAcceptCredential;
    }): Promise<CredentialRecord>;
```

## Parameters

| Parameter          | Type                                                                                                                                  | Description                                                      |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------- |
| credentialRecordId | string                                                                                                                                | The id of the credential record for which to accept the proposal |
| preview            | [CredentialPreview](./core.credentialpreview.md)                                                                                      | The new preview for negotiation                                  |
| config             | { comment?: string; credentialDefinitionId?: string; autoAcceptCredential?: [AutoAcceptCredential](./core.autoacceptcredential.md); } | <i>(Optional)</i> Additional configuration to use for the offer  |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;[CredentialRecord](./core.credentialrecord.md)&gt;

Credential record associated with the credential offer
